description_en: Queries the details of a compliance pack in a specified account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内合规包详情
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-compliance-pack --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateCompliancePack

parameters.help_en:

CompliancePack.description_en: The details of the compliance pack

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account to which the compliance pack belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 合规包归属的管理账号ID

AggregatorId.description_en: The ID of the account group

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance pack

CompliancePackName.description_en: The name of the compliance pack

CompliancePackTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the compliance pack template

ConfigRules.description_en: The list of rules in the compliance pack

ConfigRuleName.example: 弹性IP实例带宽满足最低要求

ConfigRuleParameters.description_en: The input parameters of the rule

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the input parameter

ParameterValue.description_en: The value of the input parameter

Required.description_en:
Indicates whether the input parameter is required. Valid values:

true: The input parameter is required.

false: The input parameter is not required
Required.description_zh:
规则中参数是否必填。取值：
true：必填。
false：非必填

Description.example: 弹性IP实例可用带宽大于等于指定参数值，视为“合规”。默认值：10 MB。

ResourceTypesScope.description_en: The types of the resources that are evaluated by the rule. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
ResourceTypesScope.description_zh: 规则评估的资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
RiskLevel.description_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance pack was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建合规包的时间戳。单位：毫秒

Description.description_en: The description of the compliance pack
Description.example: 基于等保2.0三级标准，提供持续检测合规性的建议模板，帮助您提前自检并修复问题，以便快速通过正式检测。

RiskLevel.description_en:
The risk level of the compliance pack. Valid values:

1: high

2: medium

3: low
RiskLevel.description_zh:
合规包风险等级。取值：
1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险

Scope.description_en: The evaluation scope of the compliance pack

ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the regions to exclude. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
ExcludeRegionIdsScope.description_zh: 排除的地域范围，多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the resource groups to exclude. The compliance pack does not apply to resources in these groups. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
ExcludeResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源不生效。多个资源组ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the resources to exclude. The compliance pack does not apply to these resources. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
ExcludeResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包对指定资源ID无效，即不对该资源执行评估

RegionIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the regions where the compliance pack applies. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,)
RegionIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定地域ID中的资源生效

ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the resource groups where the compliance pack applies. Separate multiple resource group IDs with commas (,)
ResourceGroupIdsScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对指定资源组ID中的资源生效

ResourceIdsScope.description_en: The IDs of the resources to which the rule applies. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (,)
ResourceIdsScope.description_zh: 规则对指定资源ID生效。多个资源ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

TagKeyScope.description_en: The tag key of the resources to which the compliance pack applies
TagKeyScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键的资源生效

TagValueScope.description_en: The tag value of the resources to which the compliance pack applies
TagValueScope.description_zh: 合规包仅对绑定指定标签键值对的资源生效

Status.description_en:
The status of the compliance pack. Valid values:

ACTIVE: The compliance pack is active.

CREATING: The compliance pack is being created
Status.description_zh:
合规包状态。取值：
ACTIVE：正常。
CREATING：创建中

TemplateContent.description_en: The information about the compliance pack template. The list of rules in the template does not include user-defined function rules. You can use the template to quickly create the same compliance pack for other accounts or account groups
TemplateContent.description_zh: 当前合规包模板信息，模板中规则列表不包含自定义函数规则。可基于模板信息快速为其他账号或账号组创建同样的合规包
